title: Base64 / base32 / hex decode chain
preconditions: the artifact is text, not a binary format with its own parser
steps: file the artifact to confirm it is text
base64 -d (add '=' padding if the decoder rejects it)
try the URL-safe alphabet (- and _) if standard base64 fails
xxd -r -p for hex; base32 -d for base32
repeat while the output is printable and not yet the answer
falsifier: decoded bytes are non-printable and no answer or next layer appears
